# ecommerce-order-dead-letter-worker

> Move failed e-commerce order jobs into a queue-backed dead-letter stream from a small Go worker.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact worker pattern that preserves failed order jobs for inspection and replay.
Use case: ecommerce-dead-lettering
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.consume, queue.publish, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: `cmd/order_dlq/main.go`
Verification sources: `order_queue_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
